title: Varda tile
description: A flat, square-cornered link tile in one of three colour blocks (navy with orange type, solid orange with navy type, off-white with navy type): a small bold eyebrow and a thin up-right arrow along the top, a medium-weight heading pushed to the bottom, and an optional media cell beside or below. The whole tile shifts one shade on hover in 0.3s and the arrow nudges up-right.
notes: the tile is a grid; pass its template in className (e.g. lg:grid-cols-[1fr_2fr]) and the media cell's padding/order in mediaClassName
tones map to background / primary / secondary tokens, hovers to muted / highlight / accent
name: varda-tile

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: small bold label at the top left

props.name: title
props.description: the tile's heading, sits at the bottom of the text cell

props.name: href
props.description: where the whole tile links to

props.name: tone
props.description: colour block: navy page colour, solid orange, or off-white

props.name: size
props.description: heading scale: "lg" for the big tiles, "sm" for the short pair

props.name: media
props.description: a media cell (usually a VardaPlaceholder) next to or under the text

props.name: mediaClassName
props.description: classes for the media cell: padding, order, borders
